name: prism-tree
description: A themed IDE-style file tree for Claude Code: git status, lines changed, and a shimmer on the files Claude reads and writes, in six color presets

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Color preset for the tree, its git colors and the shimmer on files Claude touches. The ❖ button in the pane's header cycles presets too; a pick made there lasts until this option changes.

activity.title: Claude activity
activity.description: Which of Claude's file activity shimmers in the tree: files read with the Read tool or Bash readers (rg, grep, find, cat), writes and git actions, each in its own tone of the theme

glyphs.title: Glyphs
glyphs.description: Icon set: auto uses Nerd Font icons when one is installed here, except in the desktop app; plain uses Unicode only

follow.title: Follow Claude
follow.description: on: the tree scrolls to what Claude reads, writes or commits. off: the view stays where you put it and only your own scrolling moves it; highlights still show.

column.title: Right column
column.description: What the right column shows by default: date (last modified) or size (files in bytes, folders as disk usage computed in the background). The header button toggles it.
